Definition: probably remotely from G3074; Lycia, a province of Asia Minor:--Lycia.
BiblicalUsage: Lycia was a province on the southern coast of Asia Minor. Paul's ship sailed past it on the voyage to Rome, coming to Myra, a city of Lycia, after crossing the sea of Cilicia and Pamphylia.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe even a passing mention of Lycia matters, because Luke the historian kept the route, and God's purposes rode on a real ship through real seas.
